invariants.metric: mean pairwise field distance (1 - fieldAgreement) across final fields of DISTINCT seeds, warm arm
invariants.floor: >= 0.8 x the same measure on the COLD arm of the same run set (cold arm = control rung)
invariants.derivation: WP-11: if every drum starts from a similar past field, fields homogenize; the quantum breath of the moth matters more, not less. Relative-to-cold floor because absolute diversity is scene-dependent; the control rung must stay flat while warm saves passes.

the closer the warm-start, the stronger the moth's perturbation budget, so near warm-starts cannot converge to identical drums; base 0.35 preserved for cold starts (closeness 0), cap 0.5 pre-registered.

spec_sha_note: spec_sha = sha256 of the canon() form of this object; carried in every run-warm receipt
